headline: The 18 E8 holonomy characters factor canonically as C3_selector x C6_physical under n=4a+3b mod6. The rho slices are the SU9 branching dimensions 80+84+84, and their C6 spectra sum to (44,40,38,48,38,40). The power traces (248,-2,14,-8,14,-2) match the packet holonomy fingerprint exactly along the subgroup generated by (rho,a,b)=(0,1,1).
runtime_boundary: The physical C6 is a subgroup of the E8 holonomy character group, not a subgroup of the 72-element runtime packet group; packet18 remains a torsor/address bridge.
